_comment: Synthetic delivery events. Pin onto the webhook node. Includes the awkward cases: a duplicate of an order already queued, a non-delivered status, and a malformed email.

_cases.case: normal — should queue with sendAfter 7 days out
DUPLICATE of SO-1001 — must overwrite its own row, not create a second
not delivered yet — must be ignored entirely
malformed email — must be dropped before it reaches the queue
Sydney customer — tests the civil-hour guard, since 10am London is 8pm there
